shapeDecisionToCarry: All three libraries ship a multi-line text control. Astryx is TextArea (Field + rows default 3). AntD is Input.TextArea (rc-textarea). MUI has no standalone Textarea export — the unit is TextField multiline / InputBase. Do not invent a MUI Textarea. Do not invent minRows/padding until InputBase.js is opened. Input stay 115:295378 is signed — do not remint Input as Textarea.

namedSoFar.sizeDefault: md — padding only; size is not a shared axis with AntD/MUI

MUI.sourceStatus: No Textarea.js in @mui/material. Next PREPARE must open InputBase.js + TextField.js for minRows default, padding, and outlined vs standard. Do not invent.
MUI.notes: Same InputBase family as the signed Input stay. Textarea is multiline of that control, not a remint of 115:295378.

namedSoFar.style: useStyle from ./style/textarea plus shared Input style

Ant Design.open: default rows from rc-textarea; minHeight from fontSize*lineHeight*rows — read before compile
